hero_summary: Azura is a 34-floor apartment tower with 225 homes, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts as well as sub-penthouses and penthouses.
overview:
Apartment choice: Azura includes one-, two- and three-bedroom homes, alongside sub-penthouses and penthouses. Shared facilities include a swimming pool, fitness centre and kids' club.

Building profile: The tower has 34 floors and 225 apartments. It was completed in 2012 and developed by VinaCapital.

Rental fit: The range of apartment formats gives renters several household-size options within the same building. Compare the specific layout and lease terms before choosing a home.
